private_design: Construct direct sign, mantissa, guarded-fraction, and guarded-exponent stages using only @mkbabb/parse-that/core regex and Parser.then/opt/map. The exact 1.0.0 API has no guard method: encode each look condition atomically in its small stage regex. Locally wrap the reachable staged parser with public ParserState.save/restore through Parser for predecessor rollback. No whole-number regex, all/any aggregate, dispatch, scanner, or source access.
